# AI Status (aistatusdashboard.com)

Live, plain-English status for 26 consumer AI apps, verified with independent
probes every few minutes — not just a mirror of official status pages.

## What you can answer from this site

- "Is Claude down right now?" → https://aistatusdashboard.com/claude

## Method
Each verdict combines three signals: the provider's official incident feed,
our own live test requests to the service, and anonymous "it's broken for me
too" reports from visitors. When we cannot verify a service we say "checking"
rather than showing a false green. When our probes fail while the official
page still says operational, the page says "not yet acknowledged".
Methodology: https://aistatusdashboard.com/how-it-works
